lines.en: Hi Omar! It's nice to see you again.
Hi Sara! Nice to see you too. How have you been?
I'm very good, thanks. How is work these days?
We are very busy at the office. I have a lot of meetings.
Me too. I have a meeting with my manager every Monday.
By the way, I heard you travelled last month.
Yes! I went to Luxor with my family.
That's great! How was the trip?
It was amazing. The temples were beautiful.
How long did you stay there?
We stayed for three days. We took a lot of photos.
Did you try the local food there?
Of course! The food was delicious.
I want to visit Luxor one day.
You should go in winter. The weather is better.
Good idea. What are your plans for this weekend?
I'm going to visit my grandmother on Friday.
That's nice. Are you doing anything on Saturday?
Yes, I'm meeting some friends for dinner.
Where are you going to eat?
We are going to try a new restaurant in Maadi.
I know a great place there. The view is amazing.
Really? Can you send me the name?
Sure, I'll send it to you tonight.
Thanks! What about you? Any plans?
I'm not doing anything special. Maybe I'll watch a movie.
Have you seen the new Egyptian movie?
Not yet. Is it good?
Yes, my colleagues watched it and loved it.
Then I'll watch it this weekend.
Great! Tell me your opinion later.
I will. Oh, I have to go now. My meeting starts soon.
No problem. It was nice talking to you.
Nice talking to you too. Let's keep in touch.
Definitely. Have a great day!
You too. See you soon, Sara!
